# Conventional Commits Strategy

We follow the [Conventional Commits specification](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/en/v1.0.0/).

## Structure
`<type>(<scope>): <short summary>`

## Types
- `feat`: A new feature for the user
- `fix`: A bug fix
- `docs`: Documentation changes
- `style`: Formatting, missing semicolons, CSS adjustments (no code logic changes)
- `refactor`: Refactoring production code (no bug fixes, no new feature)
- `test`: Adding or modifying unit or E2E tests
- `chore`: Updating build tasks, package manager configs, etc.

## Examples
- `feat(theme): add 30 color schemes and 20 google fonts customizer drawer`
- `fix(pagination): prevent page text vertical wrapping in data table`
- `style(sidebar): remove vertical border lines from active menu items`
